'''Turbo-sleds''' were equipment used in the sport of [[turbo-sledding]] on [[Neftali/Legends|Neftali]]. Turbo-sleds could be rented at [[Ambar's Big Game, Tackle, and Gear Shop]].<ref name="BSS">''[[The Black Sands of Socorro]]''</ref>
